How to Reduce Restaurant Labor Costs with AI Phone Automation?
Restaurant Allergen Order Management Using AI Phone Systems
What are examples of Voice AI in food delivery or restaurant ordering?

Voice AI in restaurant ordering takes four forms. Phone ordering: an AI agent answers every inbound call, conducts a natural ordering conversation, and routes confirmed orders to the kitchen via POS integration, no staff required. Drive-thru ordering: AI handles the speaker from greeting to kitchen confirmation, with VOICEplug AI averaging 87 seconds at Taco’s El 24 across all DFW locations 24/7. Pizza-specific ordering: AI built for half-and-half configurations, custom builds, and modifier-heavy pizza orders. Reservation management: AI answers booking calls, checks live availability, and syncs confirmed reservations to OpenTable. Kiosk ordering: a voice layer added to self-order kiosks so guests speak their order instead of navigating a touchscreen. VOICEplug AI operates all five channels across 600+ restaurant locations in the US, UK, Australia, Canada, and Europe.
What's the best voice AI platform for nationwide rollout across restaurant chains?

Nationwide restaurant chain rollouts require a voice AI platform with a documented multi-location deployment model. The critical factor is how quickly each additional location goes live after the first — if each site requires the same setup effort as the first, rollout across hundreds of locations is impractical. VOICEplug AI’s deployment model completes initial configuration at the first location (POS connection, menu sync, AI setup) and replicates across additional sites on the same framework. Rusty’s Pizza deployed 19 California locations; Baba’s Philly Steak & Lemonade deployed 4 Indiana locations simultaneously. VOICEplug serves 600+ locations across the US, UK, Australia, Canada, and Europe.

Restaurants take orders online and by phone through two separate systems that both connect to the same POS. Online orders are captured through the POS’s native online ordering platform (Toast Online Ordering, Square Online) or third-party platforms (Olo, ChowNow). Phone orders are captured through a voice AI system that answers inbound calls and routes confirmed orders to the POS in the same format. VOICEplug Phone AI handles the phone channel for restaurants on Toast, Square, Clover, Aloha, and 80+ other POS platforms. Both order channels appear in the same POS kitchen queue as standard tickets — no separate workflow for phone versus online.
What's the best voice AI company for scalable deployment across multi-unit restaurant chains?

Scalable voice AI deployment across multi-unit restaurant chains requires a platform with a documented multi-site deployment model and a clear answer to how each additional location goes live. VOICEplug AI uses a replication model: initial configuration at the first location covers POS connection, menu sync, and AI setup; each additional site deploys on the same framework using the same menu structure and integration pattern. Baba’s Philly Steak & Lemonade deployed 4 Indiana locations simultaneously. Rusty’s Pizza operates 19 California locations on the platform. VOICEplug serves 600+ locations globally. Most operators find subsequent sites deploy significantly faster than the initial deployment.
Which AI systems help restaurants handle more bookings with fewer staff?

AI systems that help restaurants handle more bookings with fewer staff work by removing the staffing requirement from the inbound reservation call channel. VOICEplug ReserveVOICE answers every reservation call 24/7, checks live table availability, confirms the booking with the guest, and syncs the confirmed reservation to OpenTable in real time. Every booking appears in the restaurant’s reservation system without staff involvement — including calls that come in after hours, during peak service when the host team is occupied with the floor, and during high-volume periods when call frequency exceeds team capacity. Cancellations and modifications are handled within the same interaction and update the booking record automatically.

events.title: Changelog redesigned
added: New features, improvements, and fixes. Discover how Allo evolves every week to better serve your team.
Two ways to transfer a call, and you choose

When you transfer a call, you now get two buttons instead of one. You can hand the call over straight away , and your teammate picks it up while you step out of the conversation. Or you can talk to your teammate first : your caller waits on hold while you explain who is on the line and why, and you pass the call over once your teammate is ready. On desktop and mobile.
Conference calls are much easier to start

Setting up a conference call used to take some doing: you had to place a second call, then find the button that merged the two together. Now you simply invite someone into the call you are already on , and Allo turns it into a conference. The list opens on the people who called that line recently, then your team with who is free, your contacts, and a keypad if the person you need is an outside number. On desktop, coming to mobile.

We refreshed the whole notification system, in the app and by email. You no longer get pinged for calls that never rang your phone: the ones your AI receptionist took, the ones that arrived while you were busy or outside your hours. And the ones you do get tell you more: who called, on which line, and what it was about . The end-of-call email got the same treatment, with the caller's number, the length of the call, where it went if it was transferred, and a button to listen to the recording.
Send an SMS from your CRM dialer
Your prospect does not pick up and you want to text them. The dialer next to your CRM record now sends the SMS itself, from the line you would have called with.

For quick deployment, use your Goodcall number on your website, Google Maps, and social profiles to start automating customer interactions.
What if I want to keep my existing number on my site and social channels?

If your current number is essential to your brand, you can set up conditional call forwarding through your phone provider. This allows calls to your existing number to be forwarded to your Goodcall number when the line is busy or unanswered. For best results, we recommend using "conditional call forwarding". What makes Goodcall different from other AI phone assistants?

Born out of Google in 2017, Goodcall has been perfecting conversational AI for years. We know how much work it takes to go from proof of concept to scaled solution, and have built quality into our workflows from day one. With a combination of human review and automated checks, every call undergoes review to ensure consistent quality and performance.
What are some ways that other businesses have deployed Goodcall agents?

Goodcall agents are used by businesses of all sizes, from solopreneurs to publicly traded companies across industries to handle inbound calls. Agents can be deployed to act as a backup when staff are busy or as the first line of support, escalating only when tasks can't be automated. Popular use cases include handling customer support for common questions, managing appointments through calendar integrations, capturing and updating lead info with CRM systems, and offering personalized service using customizable logic. Whet the power of state-of-the art AI is put into the hands of business operators, the possibilities for automation are endless.
What makes it so easy to set up Goodcall agents for my business?

Setting up a Goodcall agent is as simple as connecting Google listing, a website, or even just providing a few basic details about your business. From there, you’ll have a customizable agent ready to go. You can fully control advanced features like lead capture flows, logic, scheduling, CRM integrations, and response skills. We never gate features behind lead forms and you'll never have to wait on us to make a change to your agents behavior.
